note: The EEPROM payload is in emulator byte order (the order mGBA, VBA-M and a raw .sav use; text such as "ADLEZBGA" reads backwards per 8 bytes), not the GameShark order, so mGBA's import (which reverses each 8-byte block) scrambles it; taken as is instead, mGBA shows it: EX-3, Klonoa x99.
